label: sec:transfer-beta-decay-q-beta-spectral-preamble
html: We assemble the categorical \mathfrak{Q}_\beta spectral bridge. We identify the bridge with closed-form tables and compute the silver-ratio \beta-decay null. This substrate-level prediction closes the silver-ratio falsifiability test. We support this construction with the nucleon normal form observability, the \beta-decay energy scale, the topological-deficit confinement, and the visualiser-anchored braid presentation.
